create_dropblock_layer: create a DropBlock layer with a given drop probability and block size for feature map regularization
run_dropblock_forward: run the DropBlock forward pass on an input tensor to randomly drop spatial regions during training
test_dropblock_warmup: test the DropBlock warmup behavior where drop probability linearly increases over the first 2000 iterations
review_dropblock_gamma: review the DropBlock _compute_gamma method that calculates the Bernoulli distribution parameter for block dropping
refactor_dropblock_padding: refactor the DropBlock forward method to use a different padding strategy for the spatial mask
